repos_data.description: MuseScore is an open source and free music notation software. For support, contribution, bug reports, visit MuseScore.org. Fork and make pull requests!
Free MCP server + REST API for music notation, for AI agents. A developer tool sponsored by Gradus — a homeschool music-composition curriculum (gradusmusic.com). Not the curriculum itself.

AI-powered FL Studio control via the Model Context Protocol. Beyond piano-roll notes — full in-DAW mixing (Mix Doctor, gain staging, EQ/comp/reverb, reference matching), routing, and composition through Claude and other MCP clients. 67 tools. Windows.
A music programming language for musicians. :notes:
